items.title: Beyond Rows to Reasoning: Agentic Retrieval for Multimodal Spreadsheet Understanding and Editing
items.title_zh: 从行到推理：面向多模态表格理解与编辑的智能体检索
items.summary: BRTR replaces single-pass retrieval with an iterative tool-calling loop for multimodal spreadsheet understanding and structured editing, supported by more than 200 hours of expert human evaluation. It reports state-of-the-art results on three spreadsheet benchmarks, surpassing prior methods by 25 percentage points on FRTR-Bench, 7 on SpreadsheetLLM and 32 on FINCH, and identifies NVIDIA NeMo Retriever 1B as the top multimodal embedding model for mixed tabular and visual data.

items.title: A Dynamic Self-Evolving Extraction System
items.title_zh: 动态自演化信息抽取系统
items.summary: DySECT is a dynamic self-evolving extraction and curation toolkit that incrementally builds a knowledge base of LLM-extracted triples, enriches it with probabilistic knowledge and graph-based reasoning, and feeds the result back into the extractor through prompt tuning, few-shot sampling or synthetic-data fine-tuning.

items.title: Codex Security: now in research preview
items.title_zh: Codex Security：现已进入研究预览
items.summary: Codex Security is an AI application security agent that analyzes project context to detect, validate and patch complex vulnerabilities with higher confidence and less noise, OpenAI says in announcing its research preview.

items.title: Compression Method Matters: Benchmark-Dependent Output Dynamics in LLM Prompt Compression
items.title_zh: 压缩方法很重要：LLM 提示压缩中随基准而变的输出动态
items.summary: A controlled replication across 5,400 API calls finds that aggressive prompt compression can sharply increase output length in benchmark-dependent ways: at r=0.3, DeepSeek expanded outputs 56x on MBPP but 5x on HumanEval, while GPT-4o-mini stayed comparatively stable. The authors identify prompt structure rather than provider identity as the primary moderator and introduce an instruction-survival metric and a Compression Robustness Index.

items.title: StratRAG: A Multi-Hop Retrieval Evaluation Dataset for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
items.title_zh: StratRAG：面向检索增强生成系统的多跳检索评测数据集
items.summary: StratRAG is an open-source retrieval evaluation dataset derived from HotpotQA's distractor setting, with 2,200 examples across bridge, comparison and yes-no questions, each paired with 15 candidate documents containing exactly 2 gold documents and 13 distractors. Hybrid retrieval performs best overall with Recall@2 of 0.70 and MRR of 0.93, while bridge questions remain harder at Recall@2 of 0.67.

items.title: Empowering Locally Deployable Medical Agent via State Enhanced Logical Skills for FHIR-based Clinical Tasks
items.title_zh: 为本地可部署医疗智能体赋能：面向 FHIR 临床任务的状态增强逻辑技能
items.summary: SELSM is a training-free framework that distills simulated clinical trajectories into entity-agnostic operational rules in an abstract skill space, then uses query-anchored two-stage retrieval to fetch logical priors during inference. On MedAgentBench with the Qwen3-30B-A3B backbone it eliminates task chain breakdowns for a 100% completion rate and raises overall success by 22.67 absolute points over memory-augmented baselines.

items.title: Evaluating Multi-Agent LLM Architectures for Rare Disease Diagnosis
items.title_zh: 评估用于罕见病诊断的多智能体 LLM 架构
items.summary: The study compares four agent topologies, Control, Hierarchical, Adversarial and Collaborative, across 302 cases spanning 33 rare disease categories, and introduces a Reasoning Gap metric separating internal knowledge retrieval from final diagnostic accuracy. Hierarchical was best at 50.0%, marginally ahead of Collaborative at 49.8% and Control at 48.5%, while Adversarial fell to 27.3% as valid diagnoses were rejected under artificial doubt.

items.title: Deep Research, Shallow Evaluation: A Case Study in Meta-Evaluation for Long-Form QA Benchmarks
items.title_zh: 深度研究，浅层评估：长文本问答基准元评估的案例研究
items.summary: A meta-evaluation case study uses ScholarQA-CS2 to validate LLM-as-judge and claim-verification methods against human pairwise preferences for long-form QA benchmarks. It finds pairwise rankings best suited to system-level evaluation, while metric-level assessment requires explicit metric-wise annotations and expert annotators.

items.title: Evaluating Generalization Mechanisms in Autonomous Cyber Attack Agents
items.title_zh: 评估自主网络攻击智能体的泛化机制
items.summary: The study isolates unseen host and subnet IP reassignment as a minimal shift in the NetSecGame environment, training agents on five IP-range variants and testing on a sixth. Some adaptation methods show partial transfer but degrade significantly, while prompt-driven pretrained LLM agents achieve the highest held-out success at the cost of more inference-time compute, reduced transparency and repetition or invalid-action loops.
